newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Resources sees Q4 EPS of $0.22-$0.24.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Resources sees Q4 EPS of $0.22-$0.24.

text.p: Alternative Resources Corp said Tuesday it expects to report earnings for the fourth quarter of about $0.22 to $0.24 a share, compared with $0.21 a share last year.
The company, which provides technical staff for information services, said it expects total revenues of $52 to $53 million for the quarter, compared with $44.4 million in the previous year's period.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates is for earnings of $0.24 a share.
The company said it expects to report actual financial results around January 22.
Alternative Resources said the improved revenues were fueled by continued growth in national accounts and better sales productivity at the branch level.
During the quarter, the company also experienced lower margins related mainly to large accounts, Alternative Resources said.
The expected results also show a significant increase in sequential quarterly revenues, the company said.
In addition, Alternative Resources said it expects to post positive earnings comparisons throughout 1997.

"With signficantly more resources behind Smartsourcing Solutions relative to a year ago and our Middle Markets initiative having reached the self-funding stage, we expect to show positive comparisons again throughout 1997," said Larry Kane, chairman and president of Alternative Resources.

"The impact on 1997 earnings from our previous investments in Smartsourcing Solutions and Middle Markets programs should lessen, while revenue momentum should continue to improve earnings," Kane said.
